MULTI_SOURCE.description: True if fused from multiple sources

TRACK_COMPONENTS.description: Number of components per point (default 3 for X, Y, Z)

ECEF_POS.description: ECEF position as flat array [X0, Y0, Z0, X1, Y1, Z1, ...]

ECEF_VEL.description: ECEF velocity as flat array [VX0, VY0, VZ0, VX1, VY1, VZ1, ...]

ECEF_ACC.description: ECEF acceleration as flat array [AX0, AY0, AZ0, AX1, AY1, AZ1, ...]

LC_POS.description: Local coordinate position as flat array

LC_VEL.description: Local coordinate velocity as flat array

LC_ACC.description: Local coordinate acceleration as flat array

COV.description: Covariance data (21 elements per point for 6x6 lower triangular)

ERR_ELLP.description: Error ellipse data (6 elements per point)

TMSModelParameter.description:
One parameter of the propagation model, stated by name so a model
registry can evolve without schema change.

NAME.description: Parameter name within the MODEL_ID model's own registry, verbatim.

UNITS.description:
Units of VALUE, verbatim. Required: a unitless parameter states so
explicitly (e.g. "1").

TMSIdentifier.description: One identity the track is known by in a named identity scheme.

SCHEME.description:
Identity scheme token, verbatim (the identity system's own name).
Never a field name and never normalized by the publisher.

VALUE.description: The identifier within that scheme, verbatim.

TMSProvenance.description:
Dataset lineage and redistribution terms for one track model state.

Required on every record: a redistributed track whose feed, epoch, and
licence are unstated is not publishable. The standard names no feed,
provider, or site.

DATASET_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the feed or dataset this
state was derived from, unique within the publisher's own dataset
registry. Never a display name and never a URL.

DATASET_NAME.description: The feed or dataset's own name, verbatim as its publisher states it.

DATASET_URL.description: Replayable URL of the feed or dataset as published.

DATASET_EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch of the dataset edition or feed
session this state was derived from.

DATASET_CID.description: Content identifier of the exact dataset artifact, when one exists.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material within the dataset.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: The exact query, filter, or subscription used.

RETRIEVED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond retrieval timestamp of the observation
this state was updated from.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Unknown terms are never public domain
and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as the source publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display.

SHARE_ALIKE.description: The licence obliges derived works to carry the same terms.

NATIVE_ID.description:
The source's own identifier for the track or observation stream this
state was derived from, verbatim.

NATIVE_MODIFIED.description:
RFC 3339 UTC instant the source last modified or emitted the
underlying observation, as the source states it.

ID.description: Publisher-stable identifier for this state record.

TRACK_ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier of the track this state belongs to, held
constant across every state update of the same track.

ENVIRONMENT.description:
Domain the track moves in. The `$TRK` enum reused verbatim; ordinal 0
is SPACE, so a publisher MUST set this field — it is defaulted to
UNKNOWN explicitly so an unset field can never be read as SPACE.

EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch this state is valid at. The
propagation origin: every kinematic field below is stated at EPOCH.

LATITUDE.description: Latitude, decimal degrees on WGS 84, positive north.

LONGITUDE.description: Longitude, decimal degrees on WGS 84, positive east, in [-180, 180].

ALTITUDE_M.description:
Altitude, metres above the WGS 84 ellipsoid. NaN for a surface track
whose source publishes no altitude.

GROUND_SPEED_MPS.description: Speed over ground, metres per second.

VELOCITY_NORTH_MPS.description:
Velocity components, metres per second, local NED-derived axes:
north, east, and up. Published when the source or filter resolves
them; NaN otherwise.

HEADING_DEG.description: Heading, degrees true, [0, 360): the direction the vehicle points.

COURSE_DEG.description: Course over ground, degrees true, [0, 360): the direction it moves.

TURN_RATE_DPS.description: Turn rate, degrees per second, positive clockwise seen from above.

VERTICAL_RATE_MPS.description: Vertical rate, metres per second, positive up.

MODEL_ID.description:
Identifier of the dead-reckoning or motion model that extrapolates
this state, a key into the publisher's model registry. Required: a
state with no model is a position report, which this record is not.

MODEL_PARAMETERS.description: Parameters of that model, named per its own registry.

PROPAGATION_VALID_UNTIL.description:
RFC 3339 UTC instant beyond which the publisher no longer stands
behind propagation of this state.

POSITION_UNCERTAINTY_M.description: 1-sigma horizontal position uncertainty at EPOCH, metres.

INNOVATION_GATE_SIGMA.description:
Gate in standard deviations: an observation whose innovation exceeds
this many sigma of POSITION_UNCERTAINTY_M breached the model and
produced this update.

INNOVATION_GATE_DISTANCE_M.description:
Gate as an absolute distance, metres, when the publisher gates on
distance rather than sigma.

TOLERANCE_M.description:
Publisher's stated tolerance, metres, within which propagation of this
state is considered to agree with truth.

TRACK_STATUS.description:
Track status. The `$TRK` enum reused verbatim; ordinal 0 is ACTIVE,
so a publisher MUST set this field on every record — an unset field
reads as ACTIVE and a consumer cannot distinguish the two.

STALE_AFTER_S.description:
Seconds after LAST_UPDATE_EPOCH at which a consumer MUST mark the
track stale.

DROP_AFTER_S.description:
Seconds after LAST_UPDATE_EPOCH at which a consumer MUST drop the
track.

LAST_UPDATE_EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch of the last source observation
that updated this track — the staleness clock origin. EPOCH may lag it
when the publisher re-emits a keepalive state.

IDENTIFIERS.description: Every identity the track is known by, scheme-tagged.
